stories.h: Flamingos beat Venezuela to reach U-17 Women's World Cup semi-finals, face Brazil next
stories.p: Nigeria's Flamingos beat Venezuela 1-0 in Morocco through a late penalty from captain Azeezat Oduntan to reach the semi-finals of the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup. They are Africa's last team in the tournament and will play Brazil on Wednesday.
body: Nigeria's under-17 women's team, the Flamingos, are into the semi-finals of the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup in Morocco.
## The match

The Flamingos beat Venezuela 1-0 in the quarter-final on Sunday, 1 November 2026, at the Mohammed VI Football Academy in Salé. Captain Azeezat Oduntan scored the winner from the penalty spot in the 89th minute after Oluebube Umejiaku was fouled in the box, a decision confirmed by a VAR review.
## What comes next

Nigeria will face Brazil in the semi-final on Wednesday, 4 November, at the Moulay El Hassan Stadium in Rabat. They are the only African side left in the competition after Ghana lost 1-0 to Japan in their quarter-final.
## Reactions

The Confederation of African Football congratulated the team on social media, celebrating their place in the last four. Nigerian fans also shared videos of the players dancing and celebrating after earlier victories in the tournament.
## Background

Nigeria has a strong record in women's youth football and has reached the later stages of age-group World Cups several times. The senior team, the Super Falcons, are the most successful side in African women's football and won another Women's Africa Cup of Nations title this year. The Flamingos' run has raised hopes of Nigeria's first-ever U-17 women's world title.
more: Azeezat Oduntan scored an 89th-minute penalty.
Nigeria play Brazil in the semi-final on Wednesday in Rabat.
They are Africa's last team in the tournament.

stories.h: Dangote cuts petrol gantry price again, now ₦1,210 per litre
stories.p: The Dangote Refinery has reportedly reduced its petrol gantry price by ₦55 to ₦1,210 per litre, citing a fall in European petrol benchmark prices. Depot prices in Lagos have also dropped, averaging about ₦1,259 per litre.
body: Petrol prices are falling again in Nigeria after the Dangote Refinery announced another cut.
## The new price

According to reports on Monday, 2 November 2026, the refinery reduced its petrol gantry price by ₦55, from ₦1,265 to ₦1,210 per litre, a drop of about 4.35 per cent. The cut was announced through marketers linked to the refinery. Industry sources said it followed a fall in the European petrol benchmark that the refinery uses to set its prices, as well as better supply.
## Depot prices

Other Lagos depots had already reduced their prices at the end of last week. Depot owners including African Terminal, Rainoil, Ardova and NIPCO were selling petrol at about ₦1,260 per litre, with Aiteo slightly lower at ₦1,255. Prices also fell in Port Harcourt and Calabar. Diesel prices have moved in the opposite direction after the refinery raised its diesel gantry price last week.
## What it means for motorists

Gantry and depot prices are what marketers pay before selling at filling stations, so the cuts could lead to lower pump prices in the coming days. However, actual pump prices also depend on transport costs and how quickly retailers pass on savings.
## Background

This is the refinery's second petrol price cut in less than a week. Since fuel subsidies were removed in 2023, prices have been set by the market, and the Dangote Refinery has become a major influence on what Nigerians pay at the pump.
more: Dangote's gantry price falls by ₦55 to ₦1,210 per litre.
The cut follows lower European petrol prices.

stories.h: Davido says he would charge $500,000 a show for a joint tour with Wizkid
stories.p: Davido has reportedly said a joint tour with Wizkid would sell out every venue and that he would charge $500,000 per show. He also explained why the two have not recorded a song together in about 10 years.
body: Davido has once again got fans talking about a possible joint tour with his long-time rival, Wizkid.
## What he said

In an interview on the IONWANNATALK show, clips of which spread online on 1 and 2 November 2026, Davido reportedly said that if he and Wizkid toured together, he would ask for $500,000 per show because every venue would sell out. He was less sure that a joint song would be a hit, pointing to past collaborations between big stars that he said did not do as well as expected.
## On the rivalry

Davido said the two had not recorded together in about 10 years, not because they could not work together, but because they were not in the same mental space. He acknowledged that people have different views on whether the rivalry helped or hurt their careers, and said he had once felt strongly about their differences but no longer did.
## Background

Davido and Wizkid are two of the biggest names in Afrobeats. They collaborated in the early 2010s, but fans have long been divided into rival camps, and the two have occasionally traded words online. Davido has been in the news this week over his breakdown in relations with VeryDarkMan and his support for Zlatan's song 'Inferno'.
## How fans reacted
Fans were excited by the idea of a joint tour, with many saying it would be the biggest event in African music. Wizkid had not responded at the time of the report.
more: Davido says a joint tour would sell out every venue.
He would charge $500,000 per show.

stories.h: Former Labour Party chairman Abure rules out backing Obi, open to Tinubu or Atiku
stories.p: Julius Abure, the former national chairman of the Labour Party, has reportedly said he will not support Peter Obi in 2027 but could back either President Tinubu or Atiku Abubakar. Obi's camp says it has moved on.
body: Julius Abure, who led the Labour Party when Peter Obi was its presidential candidate in 2023, has said he will not support Obi in the 2027 election.
## What he said

In a newspaper interview reported on Monday, 2 November 2026, Abure reportedly said he was open to working with any of the major candidates but was very sure he would not back Obi, who is now the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) candidate. He said he could support either President Bola Tinubu or Atiku Abubakar of the ADC, depending on the outcome of a pending Supreme Court case on the Labour Party's leadership, whether a candidate's agenda matches his views, and how acceptable the candidate is to voters. He said that if the court has not ruled by the end of November, he will consult his supporters.
## His criticism of Obi

Abure argued that Obi had squandered the goodwill and structures that helped him win more than six million votes in 2023, and predicted he would do worse in 2027. He also questioned Obi's leadership, accusing him and Abia Governor Alex Otti of undermining the party.
## The other side

Obi's allies have previously accused Abure of breaking an agreement to hold an inclusive party convention. The NDC and Obi's camp dismissed his latest comments, saying they have moved on and are focused on the election.
## Background
The Labour Party has been split by a long leadership dispute since the 2023 election, which eventually led Obi to leave and join the NDC.
more: Abure says he will not support Obi.
He could back Tinubu or Atiku depending on a court case.

stories.h: Goodluck and Patience Jonathan among guests at singer L.A.X's Lagos wedding
stories.p: Former President Goodluck Jonathan and his wife Patience were among high-profile guests at singer L.A.X's wedding reception in Lagos, hosted by his father, SIFAX Group chairman Taiwo Afolabi. The Emir of Kano, Muhammadu Sanusi II, also attended.
body: Singer L.A.X's wedding celebration in Lagos turned into a gathering of political, royal and entertainment heavyweights.
## The wedding

The singer, whose real name is Damilola Afolabi, held his wedding reception on Victoria Island on Sunday, 1 November 2026. It was hosted by his father, Taiwo Afolabi, chairman of the SIFAX Group. The couple had earlier held a civil ceremony in Malta in September and an Islamic wedding ceremony on 29 October.
## The guests

Former President Goodluck Jonathan and his wife, Patience Jonathan, were among the guests, along with the Emir of Kano, Muhammadu Sanusi II, several traditional rulers and stars from the entertainment industry. Lagos monarch Oba Saheed Elegushi and his wife were also pictured at the event.
## How people reacted

Photos and videos of the former First Lady drew warm and nostalgic reactions online. Many users recalled her time in office with affection, while others remembered the viral moments from her public appearances. Fans also congratulated L.A.X on his marriage and remarked on the high-profile guest list.
## Background
L.A.X rose to fame in the mid-2010s with hits such as 'Caro' with Wizkid. His father, Taiwo Afolabi, is a prominent businessman in the maritime sector and a well-known figure in Nigerian society.
more: The reception was hosted by SIFAX chairman Taiwo Afolabi.
The Jonathans and the Emir of Kano attended.

stories.h: Groom reportedly walks out of wedding in Imo State after bride's family demands ₦1.2 million bride price
stories.p: A groom in Mbaise, Imo State, has reportedly walked away from his traditional wedding after the bride's family allegedly demanded ₦1.2 million as bride price. The incident has reopened debate about the cost of traditional marriage in Nigeria.
body: What was supposed to be a beautiful celebration of love reportedly took an unexpected turn in Mbaise, Imo State, after a groom allegedly walked away from his bride and their traditional wedding arrangements.
## What reportedly happened
According to reports circulating online, trouble began when the bride's family demanded ₦1.2 million as bride price, a sum that reportedly did not sit well with the groom.
Rather than go ahead with the marriage under those conditions, the man allegedly called everything off, leaving the bride and both families in an embarrassing situation.
## The cost of getting married
The incident has raised fresh questions about the financial demands sometimes placed on intending couples during traditional marriage ceremonies.
Some people believe families have every right to uphold their marriage customs. Others argue that excessive financial demands can discourage young people who genuinely want to settle down.

The full circumstances of the reported incident, including whether the ₦1.2 million covered only the bride price or other traditional marriage expenses as well, have not been independently confirmed, and the people involved have not been identified.
## Over to you
Should a man walk away from a marriage because of expensive traditional demands, or should both families find a way to reach an agreement?
What would you do if you were in his shoes?
more: The incident reportedly happened in Mbaise, Imo State.
The bride's family allegedly asked for ₦1.2 million.
The details have not been independently confirmed.

stories.h: Nathaniel Bassey becomes first African gospel singer to pass 1 billion YouTube views
stories.p: Gospel singer and pastor Nathaniel Bassey has reportedly become the first African gospel artist to pass one billion views on YouTube. The milestone came during this month's edition of his Hallelujah Challenge worship programme.
body: Nigerian gospel singer and pastor Nathaniel Bassey has reached a milestone no other African gospel artist has achieved, according to reports on Monday, 2 November 2026.
## The milestone

His main YouTube channel had passed 1.014 billion views at the time of reporting, with about 5.24 million subscribers. The channel has been active since 2011. Among his most popular songs are 'Imela', 'Onise Iyanu', 'Olowogbogboro' and 'You Are God', which are sung in churches across Nigeria and the diaspora.
## The Hallelujah Challenge

The milestone came during the October 2026 edition of the Hallelujah Challenge, the midnight prayer and worship programme Bassey started in 2017. It runs twice a year and draws huge online audiences, with many viewers joining live on Instagram and YouTube. Earlier this week, a plane crash survivor shared a testimony during the programme, and a Muslim woman's decision to join drew attention online.
## A non-commercial approach

Some of Bassey's followers have suggested he should make money from the large audience. He has previously described the Hallelujah Challenge as a spiritual exercise focused on devotion and worship rather than revenue. He did not give a public statement about the milestone at the time of reporting.
## Background

Bassey, who is also a trumpeter, has become one of the best-known voices in Nigerian worship music. His success shows the growing global reach of Nigerian gospel music, which has produced several international stars in recent years.
## How fans reacted
Fans celebrated the news online, describing it as a proud moment for African gospel music.
more: His channel has more than 1.01 billion views and 5.24 million subscribers.
The milestone came during the Hallelujah Challenge.
He is the first African gospel artist to reach the mark.

stories.h: Tinubu hosts governors, Ribadu and Gbajabiamila at dinner in Makkah
stories.p: President Tinubu hosted a dinner for members of his delegation in Makkah on Sunday, including the governors of Yobe, Kaduna, Jigawa, Sokoto and Borno, NSA Nuhu Ribadu and Chief of Staff Femi Gbajabiamila. He prayed for Nigeria and urged citizens to see the country's diversity as a strength.
body: President Bola Tinubu has hosted senior government officials, state governors and business leaders at a dinner in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, during his Umrah pilgrimage.
## Who attended

According to a statement by the President's adviser on information and strategy, Bayo Onanuga, on Sunday, 1 November 2026, those at the dinner included Yobe Governor Mai Mala Buni, Kaduna Governor Uba Sani, Jigawa Governor Mohammed Namadi, Sokoto Governor Ahmed Aliyu and Borno Governor Babagana Zulum. Also present were National Security Adviser Nuhu Ribadu, Chief of Staff Femi Gbajabiamila, Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate, political adviser Ibrahim Masari and Oando chief executive Wale Tinubu. Kwara Governor Abdulrahman AbdulRazaq, BUA chairman Abdul Samad Rabiu and Attorney-General Lateef Fagbemi also spoke at the event.
## What the President said

Tinubu reportedly prayed for peace, unity and prosperity in Nigeria and urged Nigerians to see the country's ethnic, religious and cultural diversity as a strength. He said Nigeria's people and natural resources provide a foundation for an inclusive and prosperous nation, and asked God to turn the country's diversity into prosperity. Guests offered prayers for the President and the country.
## Background

Tinubu travelled to Saudi Arabia on 29 October for the Umrah pilgrimage. The trip has been criticised by opposition figures, including Atiku Abubakar, who claimed it was a cover for travel to France, and activist Omoyele Sowore, who claimed it was for medical treatment. The Presidency has rejected both claims. It says the President is expected back in Nigeria this week.
## How people reacted
Supporters shared photos of the dinner as evidence of the President's good health, while critics questioned the cost of taking a large delegation abroad.
more: Five governors, Ribadu and Gbajabiamila were among the guests.
Tinubu urged Nigerians to see diversity as a strength.

stories.h: Seun Okinbaloye says his 2027 rigging warning named no party or candidate
stories.p: Channels TV anchor Seun Okinbaloye has clarified his widely shared warning about rigging in the 2027 elections, saying it did not accuse any party, candidate or sponsor. Reactions remain divided, with some praising his courage and others accusing him of backtracking.
body: Popular Channels Television anchor Seun Okinbaloye has responded to the storm over his recent comments on election rigging ahead of 2027.
## What he said

Speaking on the channel on Sunday, 1 November 2026, Okinbaloye said his earlier remarks had been widely misread. He said his warning had named no political party, accused no candidate and identified no sponsor. Critics had interpreted his original comments as a claim that rigging of the 2027 elections had already begun.
## Background

Okinbaloye's original warning went viral last week, coming amid wider concerns about the integrity of the voter register after INEC admitted that some of its registration officers had entered AI-generated photos. Opposition candidates, including Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi, have called for audits and promised to prosecute anyone involved in rigging. INEC says the register is still being cleaned up and will be certified in December.
## How people reacted

Opinion was divided. Some viewers praised the anchor for speaking out and for clarifying his position, saying he was simply doing his job as a journalist. Others accused him of damage control and asked why he had not named those he believed were planning to rig. Several users said INEC itself should identify and prosecute staff involved in irregularities in the register.
## Why it matters

Okinbaloye presents one of Nigeria's most-watched political programmes, and his comments carry weight with voters and politicians alike. The debate shows how sensitive questions about election credibility have become as campaigning intensifies.
more: Okinbaloye says his warning named no party, candidate or sponsor.
He says his earlier comments were misread.
Reactions remain divided online.

stories.h: Yul Edochie shares date-night video with Judy Austin amid breakup rumours
stories.p: Yul Edochie has posted a cosy video with his second wife, Judy Austin, after weeks of quiet that led fans to speculate about a split. Judy also called him her 'baby for life', but some fans remain sceptical.
body: Nollywood actor Yul Edochie appears to have answered rumours about the state of his marriage to actress Judy Austin with a romantic video.
## What they posted

On Sunday, 1 November 2026, Yul shared an Instagram video of himself and Judy relaxing together on a night out, wishing fans a happy new month. Judy also shared footage from the date night, describing him as her partner for life. Neither addressed the rumours directly.
## The rumours

The couple had been unusually quiet on social media in recent weeks, which led some fans to speculate that they had split. Some even linked Yul to another actress after he attended her birthday party, claims that were never confirmed.
## How people reacted

Reactions were mixed. Some fans welcomed the video and said it put the rumours to rest, while others questioned whether the couple were truly happy and described the post as damage control. Yul also drew criticism this week for reposting a fan-made video about his life that included footage of his first wife, May Edochie.
## Background

Yul Edochie, the son of veteran actor Pete Edochie, announced in 2022 that he had taken Judy Austin as a second wife, sparking a long public dispute with May Edochie, his first wife. May later went to court over the marriage, and the matter has remained a talking point among Nollywood fans. Yul also defended polygamy this week in a discussion about a US pastor's second marriage.
more: Yul shared a cosy date-night video with Judy Austin.

stories.h: Havertz goal gives Arsenal first league win at Anfield in 14 years, sends them top
stories.p: Arsenal beat Liverpool 1-0 at Anfield on Sunday through Kai Havertz's early goal, moving to the top of the Premier League with 24 points. It was the Gunners' first league win at Anfield in 14 years.
body: Arsenal have moved to the top of the Premier League after ending a long wait for a league win at Anfield.
## The match

Kai Havertz scored the only goal in the 16th minute on Sunday, 1 November 2026, turning in a cross from Declan Rice at the back post. Liverpool controlled long spells of the game and pushed hard for an equaliser, with two penalty appeals turned down and Florian Wirtz hitting the crossbar from a free-kick. Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya denied Alexander Isak, while at the other end Alisson made a late save to stop substitute Christos Tzolis from doubling the lead.
## The table

The result takes Arsenal to 24 points, three ahead of Manchester City, who reportedly lost to Brighton on the same day. It was Arsenal's first league win at Anfield in 14 years, ending a run of 13 league visits without victory.
## What Arteta said

Manager Mikel Arteta told the BBC that the win was for everyone connected to the club and that 14 years without a victory at Anfield was a long time. He praised his players' performance but said it was too early to talk about the title race, adding that the team would now prepare for a big European match in Prague.
## Why it matters

Arsenal have finished as runners-up in recent seasons and are hoping to win their first league title since 2004. The win at one of the hardest grounds in English football will boost their belief, while Liverpool will be disappointed not to have taken anything from a game they dominated for long periods.
more: Havertz scored in the 16th minute from Rice's cross.
Arsenal are top with 24 points, three ahead of Manchester City.

stories.h: Yahaya Bello vows to spend two weeks in Kano campaigning for Tinubu
stories.p: Former Kogi governor Yahaya Bello has reportedly pledged to move to Kano for two weeks to campaign for President Tinubu and Governor Abba Yusuf. He urged non-indigenous communities in the state to deliver more votes than in 2023.
body: Former Kogi State Governor Yahaya Bello has promised to personally campaign in Kano for President Bola Tinubu's re-election.
## What he said

Speaking at a political mobilisation and empowerment programme for Yoruba and other non-indigenous communities in Kano, organised by the foundation of Rep. Leke Abejide and reported on Sunday, 1 November 2026, Bello said he would move to Kano for two weeks to campaign for the President and for Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf. He urged non-indigenous communities in the state to beat the nearly 500,000 votes they reportedly gave Tinubu in 2023, and said Abejide's network could deliver at least two million votes. He also pointed to work on the Kano–Abuja highway as evidence of the President's commitment to the North.
## Support for communities

Abejide, who represents Yagba Federal Constituency in Kogi State and holds a Yoruba community title in Kano, announced ₦500 million in interest-free loans for women's cooperatives, along with support for widows. He said programmes for young people and men are being planned.
## Background

Kano has the second-highest number of registered voters in Nigeria after Lagos, and the APC is investing heavily there after Governor Yusuf moved from the NNPP to the APC. The state is also the home of Rabiu Kwankwaso, Peter Obi's running mate on the NDC ticket. Bello, who governed Kogi from 2016 to 2024, is facing a money-laundering case brought by the EFCC, which he denies. Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin also predicted a Tinubu victory at an APC event in Kano on Sunday.
## What happens next
The campaign in Kano is expected to intensify as the APC and NDC compete for the state's large vote.
more: Bello says he will spend two weeks campaigning in Kano.
He wants non-indigenous communities to deliver more votes than in 2023.

stories.h: Atiku says Tinubu has broken his promise of constant electricity
stories.p: Atiku Abubakar's campaign has accused President Tinubu of failing to keep his 2022 promise to provide constant electricity within four years. The ADC candidate says settling power-sector debts and passing laws is not the same as delivering power, and pledged to replace the band tariff system.
body: The presidential campaign of Atiku Abubakar has accused President Bola Tinubu of breaking a key campaign promise on electricity.
## What Atiku's campaign said

In a statement issued on Sunday, 1 November 2026, by Phrank Shaibu, communications director of the ADC presidential campaign, the campaign recalled that Tinubu promised during his 2022 campaign that Nigerians should not vote for him again if he failed to provide constant electricity in four years. The statement accused the ruling APC of hiding the failure behind announcements of new laws, bonds and committees, saying that settling old debts owed to power companies is not the same as building new generation capacity. It argued that signing a law or raising a bond does not produce electricity.
## Tariffs and taxes

The campaign also questioned what would happen to electricity bills when subsidies end in 2027, although officials have said there will be no immediate tariff rise. It criticised a planned 5 per cent surcharge on some fuels under the Nigeria Tax Act, which the government says is not yet active. Atiku pledged to work with states and regulators to replace the current band system with a framework based on how much electricity customers actually receive.
## The government's position

The Federal Government says it is fixing the power sector step by step. This week the Federal Executive Council approved procurement for new East and West super grids to raise transmission capacity to 19,000MW within two years, and the Minister of Power set a long-term target of 70,000MW by 2060. The government has also paid part of the debts owed to gas suppliers and power companies. The APC had not responded to Atiku's latest statement at the time of the report.
## Why it matters
Electricity supply is one of the issues that matter most to voters, and all the main candidates have made promises on power.
more: Atiku says Tinubu has not delivered the constant power he promised in 2022.
He says paying debts and passing laws is not the same as generating power.
He promises to replace the band tariff system.

stories.h: Barau predicts Tinubu victory as APC inaugurates campaign committees in Kano
stories.p: Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin has reportedly declared that President Tinubu will win the 2027 election, speaking at the inauguration of APC campaign committees in three Kano local government areas. He also welcomed Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf's move to the APC.
body: Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin has predicted victory for President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 presidential election.
## What he said

Speaking at the inauguration of APC campaign committees for Dawakin Tofa, Tofa and Rimin Gado local government areas in Kano State on Sunday, 1 November 2026, Barau reportedly said that, by God's grace, all indications showed Tinubu would win. He based his prediction on the assessment of political analysts and the direction of Nigerian politics. His media aide, Ismail Mudashir, confirmed the remarks in a statement.
## Kano's importance

Barau urged the committees, which include party officials, lawmakers, council chairmen, new members and community elders, to campaign actively so that APC candidates win at every level. He described Kano as the state with the second-highest number of registered voters after Lagos, and said it deserves more federal attention and investment. He also welcomed Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf's move from the New Nigeria Peoples Party (NNPP) to the APC.
## Background

Kano is one of the biggest prizes in the election and the home state of Rabiu Kwankwaso, who is Peter Obi's running mate on the NDC ticket. Kwankwaso's Kwankwasiyya movement has dominated Kano politics in recent years, and the governor's defection to the APC is seen as a major boost for Tinubu in the state. The NDC's governorship candidate in Kano, Abdulsalam Gwarzo, is currently missing from INEC's list because of a court order.
## What happens next
Both the APC and the NDC are expected to campaign heavily in Kano in the coming weeks.
more: Barau says all indications point to a Tinubu win.
He spoke at an APC event in three Kano LGAs.

stories.h: Fact check: Viral claim that Obi said he cannot beat Tinubu is false
stories.p: A viral post claiming Peter Obi admitted he could not beat President Tinubu has been found to be false. A review of the full recording of his Manchester town hall shows he did not mention Tinubu or say he could not win.
body: A widely shared social media post claiming that NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi admitted he could not defeat President Bola Tinubu in 2027 has been found to be false.
## The claim

An X user posted a short video of Obi with a caption attributing words to him, suggesting he had said he knew he could not beat Tinubu at the polls and was only staying in the race because young supporters asked him not to quit. The post was viewed more than 170,000 times.
## What he actually said

According to a fact check published on Sunday, 1 November 2026, the clip came from a diaspora town hall Obi held in Manchester, United Kingdom, on 18 October 2026. In the full recording, he asked supporters to back a candidate with a record of public service and told them he needed their support. A review of both the short clip and the full recording found that he did not mention Tinubu, did not say he could not win, and did not talk about quitting the race.
## Verdict
The claim is false. There is no evidence that Obi made the statement attributed to him in the caption.
## Why it matters

Misleading captions on genuine videos are one of the most common forms of false information during election campaigns. INEC and civil society groups have warned about deepfakes and fake news ahead of the 2027 elections, and voters are advised to check claims against full recordings or trusted sources before sharing them.
more: The viral caption put false words in Obi's mouth.
The clip came from his Manchester town hall on 18 October.
He did not mention Tinubu or quitting the race.

stories.h: BON Awards 2026: 'Love and New Notes' leads nominations with nine
stories.p: Nominations for the 18th Best of Nollywood Awards have been announced, with 'Love and New Notes' leading with nine nods, followed by 'The Herd' with eight. Uzor Arukwe, Kanayo O. Kanayo and Timini Egbuson are among the Best Actor nominees, and the ceremony will hold in Enugu State.
body: The nominees for the 2026 Best of Nollywood (BON) Awards have been announced, with romantic film 'Love and New Notes' leading the pack.
## The leading films

According to the list released on Sunday, 1 November 2026, 'Love and New Notes' received nine nominations, followed by 'The Herd' with eight. 'The Creek', 'Aba Blues', 'Colours of Fire' and 'Efunroye: The Unicorn' each received seven, while '3 Cold Dishes' got six. 'Behind the Scenes' and 'Agesinkole (King of Thieves) 2' received five each.
## Acting categories

Best Actor nominees include Bucci Franklin for 'The Creek', Kanayo O. Kanayo for 'Grandpa Must Obey', Jide Kene Achufusi for 'Aba Blues', Timini Egbuson for 'Love and New Notes', Uzor Arukwe for 'Colours of Fire' and Wale Ojo for '3 Cold Dishes'. The Best Actress category features Scarlet Gomez, Osas Ighodaro, Mercy Aigbe, Sharon Ooja and Nse Ikpe-Etim. Supporting actress nominees include Eniola Badmus, Destiny Etiko, Nancy Isime and Bisola Aiyeola.
## The ceremony
The 18th edition of the awards will be held in Enugu State. The exact date has not been announced.
## Background

The Best of Nollywood Awards, founded by the publishers of Best of Nollywood magazine, are among the longest-running Nigerian film awards and move to a different state each year. Uzor Arukwe's nomination comes in a week when he spoke openly about being sacked from a telecoms job before his acting career and about being typecast in similar roles.
## How fans reacted
Fans shared their favourites online, with many backing Timini Egbuson and Uzor Arukwe in a strong Best Actor category.
more: 'Love and New Notes' leads with nine nominations.
'The Herd' follows with eight.
The ceremony will hold in Enugu State.

stories.h: VeryDarkMan brings out cash counting machine after claiming record ₦90 million sales in one day
stories.p: VeryDarkMan has brought out a cash counting machine to count money reportedly received from sales of his RATEL products, after saying the business made ₦90 million in a single day. He has also promised to make his bank statement public to clear any doubts.
body: Social media activist and businessman VeryDarkMan (VDM) has once again got people talking, this time after bringing out a cash counting machine to count money reportedly received from the sale of his RATEL products.
Photos show him and a colleague surrounded by bundles of naira notes, with an open suitcase full of cash, stacks of money on cartons of RATEL power stations and a counting machine beside them.
## A record day
According to VDM, the business recorded about ₦90 million in sales in one day, the biggest single-day figure since the products were launched.
## Ready to show proof
VDM knows how Nigerians think. Once you mention ₦90 million in one day, some people will immediately start asking questions, while others will simply refuse to believe it.

To clear the doubts, he has promised to go a step further and make his bank account statement public so people can see the transactions for themselves. He appeared confident about the figures and made it clear he was ready to back up his claims with evidence.
## A fast-growing brand

What makes this development interesting is how quickly the RATEL business appears to be gaining attention. From importing products from China to demonstrating how they perform in public, VDM has continued to attract customers and supporters.
However, the ₦90 million figure has yet to be independently verified, and sales revenue should not be confused with profit.
## Over to you
If VDM can truly generate ₦90 million in sales in a single day, imagine what this business could become in the next few years.
What do you think about the speed at which VeryDarkMan is growing the RATEL brand?
more: VDM says RATEL made about ₦90 million in sales in one day.
He has promised to publish his bank statement.
The figure has not been independently verified.
stories.alt: VeryDarkMan and a colleague counting bundles of naira notes beside a cash counting machine and an open suitcase of money
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija

stories.h: Landlord seriously injured as dispute with tenant over rent increase from ₦300,000 to ₦1 million turns violent
stories.p: A disagreement between a Nigerian landlord and his tenant over renovation costs and a proposed rent increase from ₦300,000 to ₦1 million has reportedly ended in violence. The landlord was allegedly struck on the head and seriously injured.
body: A disagreement between a Nigerian landlord and his tenant over house renovation expenses and a proposed rent increase has reportedly ended in violence, leaving the landlord seriously injured.
## How it started

According to reports, trouble began when the landlord decided to raise the rent from ₦300,000 to a staggering ₦1 million. Renovation costs also became a major point of disagreement between both parties.
## The confrontation

What should have been a discussion about rent and property maintenance allegedly turned into a physical confrontation, during which the tenant reportedly struck the landlord on the head, causing serious injuries.

Photos circulating online show a man with plasters on his head and another man seated in what appears to be an office. The identities of those involved have not been confirmed, and the details of the incident have not been independently verified.
## Rising tension over rent
The incident has raised questions about the growing tension between landlords and tenants in Nigeria, at a time when many families are already struggling with the rising cost of accommodation.
Landlords have their own expenses to deal with, but tenants are equally feeling the pressure of sudden and substantial rent increases.
However serious a disagreement becomes, violence should never be the answer.
## Over to you
What do you think? Is increasing rent from ₦300,000 to ₦1 million reasonable because of renovation costs, or has the landlord gone too far?
more: The rent was reportedly raised from ₦300,000 to ₦1 million.
The landlord was allegedly struck on the head.
The details have not been independently verified.
stories.alt: A man with plasters on his head beside another man seated at an office desk, faces blurred
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija

stories.h: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya introduces new wife to Fountain of Life congregation
stories.p: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya of Fountain of Life Church has introduced his new wife, Mo Odukoya, to his congregation during Sunday service in Lagos. Pastor Tunde Bakare says the couple married in the United States and that he blessed the union.
body: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya, senior pastor of Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos, has remarried and presented his new wife to his church.
## What happened

During Sunday service on 1 November 2026, Odukoya introduced his wife, who will be known as Pastor Mo Odukoya, to the congregation. Days earlier, he had sparked engagement rumours by sharing a photo of two hands wearing rings, captioned as a new beginning. According to Pastor Tunde Bakare, General Overseer of The Citadel Global Community Church, the wedding took place in the United States and he blessed the marriage. Bakare said the bride is the daughter of Reverend Theophilus and Bolaji Daniel.
## What the pastor said

Odukoya reportedly told the congregation that he had remained single since taking over the leadership of the church and felt called to remarry, referring to the biblical teaching that it is not good for a man to be alone.
## Background

Jimmy Odukoya, an actor and pastor, took over as senior pastor of Fountain of Life Church after the death of his father, Pastor Taiwo Odukoya, in 2023. He played the lead role in the 2023 film 'Orisa'. He was previously married to Kemi Odukoya, with whom he has children.
## How people reacted

Many church members and fans congratulated the couple and shared videos from the service. Others used the moment to debate remarriage and divorce in the church, with some asking questions about his previous marriage. Odukoya has not publicly commented on those questions.
more: He introduced Pastor Mo Odukoya during Sunday service.
Tunde Bakare says the wedding took place in the US.
He says he felt called to remarry.

stories.h: Adeboye says he never carried a placard against Jonathan, calls it a march against corruption
stories.p: RCCG General Overseer Pastor Enoch Adeboye has denied carrying a placard against former President Goodluck Jonathan, saying the event was a prayer walk against corruption. He said he has never protested against any government.
body: The General Overseer of the Redeemed Christian Church of God (RCCG), Pastor Enoch Adeboye, has responded to claims that he once protested against former President Goodluck Jonathan's government.
## What he said

Speaking at the church's monthly Holy Ghost Service, in comments reported on Sunday, 1 November 2026, Adeboye said he did not carry any placard against Jonathan. He explained that the event was a prayer walk and a march against corruption, aimed at drawing attention to the country's problems. He added that he has never protested against any government and that his role is to pray for those in authority.
## Why it came up

Clips and posts claiming that the cleric had carried a placard against the Jonathan administration have circulated online in recent weeks, as supporters of different candidates debate the role of religious leaders in politics ahead of the 2027 elections. Some critics argued that church leaders who spoke out under Jonathan have been quieter under the current government.
## Background

Adeboye leads one of Nigeria's largest churches, with branches around the world, and his statements are closely followed. Religious leaders have played a prominent part in national debates on insecurity and the economy. Several pastors and Islamic clerics have also spoken out this week about the elections and religious freedom.
## How people reacted
His explanation drew mixed reactions. Some members welcomed the clarification, while others insisted the march was widely seen as a protest at the time.
more: Adeboye says it was a prayer walk against corruption.
He says he has never protested against any government.
The claim circulated online amid election debates.

stories.h: APC supporters reportedly attacked and vehicle burnt before Katsina governor's rally
stories.p: Suspected hoodlums reportedly attacked APC supporters travelling to Governor Dikko Radda's campaign rally in Faskari, Katsina State, on Saturday and set a campaign vehicle on fire. Several people were injured, and police had not commented at the time of the report.
body: Violence has again marred campaigning in Katsina State, with supporters of the All Progressives Congress (APC) reportedly attacked on their way to a rally by Governor Dikko Umaru Radda.
## What happened

According to reports on Sunday, 1 November 2026, suspected hoodlums ambushed APC supporters in Yankara town, Faskari Local Government Area, on Saturday as they travelled to a rally for President Bola Tinubu and the governor's 2027 campaigns. The attackers reportedly blocked a major road used by the campaign convoy and set fire to a campaign vehicle belonging to a support group, the Musa Adamu Network. The violence reportedly followed a religious procession in the area, which the attackers are said to have exploited. Several people were injured. A witness claimed there were deaths, but this has not been independently confirmed.
## Reactions

The governor went ahead with the rally. The secretary of the Musa Adamu Network condemned the attack and called on security agencies to identify and prosecute those responsible, while the state APC chairman, Bishir Saulawa, pledged a peaceful, issue-based campaign. The police had not commented at the time of the report.
## Background

It is the second reported attack on an APC campaign in Katsina in less than a week, after suspected thugs disrupted a rally in Malumfashi. Opposition figures have also reported attacks, including on AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore in Ekiti and the ADC governorship candidate in Sokoto. Atiku Abubakar and other leaders have called for investigations and warned against political violence.
## What happens next
Security agencies are under pressure to ensure safe campaigning as parties step up their activities ahead of the January 2027 elections.
more: Supporters were reportedly ambushed on the way to Radda's rally in Faskari.
A campaign vehicle was set on fire and several people were injured.
Police had not commented at the time of the report.

stories.h: Bank marketer allegedly caught cheating with customer, her explanation leaves husband speechless
stories.p: A married woman said to work as a bank marketer is at the centre of an online controversy after her husband allegedly caught her with one of the bank's customers. The explanation she reportedly gave when confronted has got people talking, although none of the details have been independently verified.
body: A married woman who reportedly works as a bank marketer has found herself at the centre of a heated online controversy after her husband allegedly caught her having an affair with one of the bank's customers.
## When customer relations go too far
Everyone knows bank marketers are expected to keep good relationships with their customers. Attracting clients and keeping them happy is part of the job.
But in this case, the woman allegedly took customer relations far beyond anything her husband ever imagined.
## The explanation
What has made the story even more talked about is the explanation she reportedly gave after being confronted, which is said to have left her husband speechless.

The exact details of her response, and of the incident itself, have not been independently verified, and the people involved have not been identified. Even so, the story has sparked fresh conversation about trust, marriage and the boundaries of professional relationships.
## Over to you
Seriously, how do you explain something like this to your husband?
Was she simply doing her job, or did customer service become something else entirely?
more: The woman reportedly works as a bank marketer.
Her explanation has not been independently verified.
The story has sparked debate about professional boundaries.
stories.alt: A woman wrapped in a bedsheet on a bed as two men stand in the bedroom, faces blurred
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija

stories.h: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya introduces new wife as Fountain of Life Church welcomes another 'Mummy G.O.'
stories.p: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya, Senior Pastor of The Fountain of Life Church, has reportedly introduced his new wife to the congregation. The news has revived an old debate about how Nigerian churches treat divorce among their leaders compared with ordinary members.
body: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya, the Senior Pastor of The Fountain of Life Church, has reportedly introduced his new wife to the congregation, bringing fresh attention to his personal life and to the church's leadership.
Photos from the occasion show the couple dressed in matching red outfits, smiling together on the church stage.
## Background
For those who may not know, Pastor Jimmy was previously married to Kemi Odukoya, and the marriage produced two children. That marriage reportedly ended some years ago.

His sister, who also serves as an associate pastor in the church, has spoken publicly about the breakdown of her own marriage, including her personal experiences and how her faith in God carried her through that difficult period.
The Fountain of Life Church was founded by their late parents, Pastors Taiwo and Bimbo Odukoya, and the children have continued the family's ministry.
## A question about double standards
The news raises a question about how marriage and divorce are discussed in some Nigerian churches.

Many religious institutions regularly remind ordinary members that marriage is sacred and that the Bible says God hates divorce. Some believers are even made to feel guilty for leaving marriages that have become unbearable.

Yet when divorce happens within prominent pastoral families, the conversation often becomes more understanding. Suddenly, people are encouraged to consider personal circumstances, healing, forgiveness and new beginnings.
Perhaps they should. Pastors are human beings too. But shouldn't ordinary church members receive that same understanding?
## Finding love again

There is nothing wrong with anyone finding love again after a failed marriage. The concern is the apparent gap between what some churches preach to their members and how they respond when their own leaders face similar situations.
So the question is this: if divorce can be understood and accepted when it involves church leaders, why should ordinary Christians sometimes be made to feel condemned for the same decision?
What is your opinion?
more: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya was previously married to Kemi Odukoya.
The church was founded by his late parents, Taiwo and Bimbo Odukoya.
The news has reopened debate about how churches handle divorce.
stories.alt: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya and his new wife in matching red outfits on a church stage
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija

stories.h: Sanwo-Olu becomes 'part-time model' on Lagos Fashion Week runway
stories.p: Lagos Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu walked the runway at Lagos Fashion Week on Saturday in an outfit from designer Ugo Monye's collection, drawing cheers from the crowd. He shared the video online, calling himself a model for one night.
body: Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu surprised fashion lovers by taking to the runway at Lagos Fashion Week on Saturday night, 31 October 2026.
## What happened

The governor modelled a native outfit from the collection of designer Ugo Monye, walking the catwalk to loud cheers from the audience. At the end of the show, he returned to the runway with the designer, and the two shook hands and walked out together to applause.
## What he said

Sanwo-Olu shared footage of the moment on his social media pages, describing it as a welcome break from his usual work and calling himself a part-time model for the night. He said he had a really good time and congratulated the designer and everyone working to make Lagos a hub of creativity, fashion and talent.
## How people reacted

The video drew warm and humorous reactions. Actress Funke Akindele described it as dope, while broadcaster Do2dtun praised the governor for supporting the entertainment industry. Other users joked that the governor had found a side hustle.
## Background

Lagos Fashion Week is one of Africa's biggest fashion events and showcases designers from Nigeria and across the continent. Sanwo-Olu, who is serving his second and final term, often appears at cultural and entertainment events in the state and has promoted Lagos as a centre for the creative economy. Earlier this week, a video of him giving flowers to his wife also went viral.
more: Sanwo-Olu modelled an outfit by designer Ugo Monye.
He called himself a 'part-time model' for the night.
Funke Akindele and Do2dtun praised the moment.

stories.h: Federal government's CREDICORP unveils SPARK loans for people without smartphones
stories.p: The Nigerian Consumer Credit Corporation has unveiled SPARK, a credit product that lets people borrow through USSD on basic mobile phones, without internet access. It is aimed at first-time and low-income borrowers and is expected to be widely available before the end of 2026.
body: Nigerians without smartphones or internet access may soon be able to borrow money through a new government-backed scheme.
## What was unveiled

The Nigerian Consumer Credit Corporation (CREDICORP) launched SPARK at a 'CREDICORP for All' event in Aba, Abia State, attended by more than 1,000 residents, according to reports on Sunday, 1 November 2026. The product works on USSD, the basic mobile service available on simple feature phones, allowing eligible users to start credit transactions without a data connection.
## Who it is for

SPARK is aimed at first-time borrowers, low-income earners and others who are poorly served by traditional banks. CREDICORP says it will also help users build formal credit histories by borrowing and repaying responsibly. Loan sizes, interest rates and eligibility rules were not disclosed, and the USSD code has not yet been published. CREDICORP expects the product to be widely available before the end of 2026.
## Who spoke
CREDICORP's chief executive, Uzoma Nwagba, spoke at the event, along with a representative of Abia Governor Alex Otti and an official of the Ministry of Finance Incorporated.
## Background

CREDICORP was set up in 2024 to expand access to consumer credit, so that Nigerians can buy goods such as phones, solar systems and household items and pay over time. Many Nigerians rely on online loan apps, some of which have been criticised for high interest rates and harsh debt-recovery methods.
## A warning
Officials urged people to wait for official announcements and to avoid unverified platforms claiming to register people for SPARK loans.
more: SPARK works through USSD on basic phones.
It targets first-time and low-income borrowers.
Loan sizes and interest rates have not been announced.
stories.credit: Photo: CBN / Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

stories.h: UK splits post-study work visa into two tiers from 2027
stories.p: The UK is changing its Graduate visa from January 2027: most bachelor's and master's graduates will get 18 months instead of two years, while graduates of universities with strong compliance and job records will keep two years. Nigerians are among the biggest users of the route.
body: Nigerian students planning to study in the United Kingdom will face new rules on how long they can stay and work after graduation, under changes announced in the UK government's 2026 Budget.
## What is changing

From 1 January 2027, the Graduate visa will reportedly be split into two tiers. Most bachelor's and master's graduates will be allowed 18 months to stay and work, down from two years. Graduates of universities with strong immigration compliance records and good graduate job outcomes will keep two years. Doctoral graduates will keep their existing three years. Applications submitted before 1 January 2027 will be decided under the current rules.
## Unanswered questions

The UK government has not yet published the list of qualifying universities or the exact criteria that will be used. The change partly reverses an earlier plan to cut the visa to 18 months for everyone.
## Why it matters for Nigerians

Nigeria was the third-largest source of sponsored study visas to the UK in the year to June 2026, with more than 26,000 main applicants, behind only China and India. More than 20,000 Nigerians were granted permission on the Graduate route in the same period. Prospective students are being advised to check a university's immigration compliance record and graduate employment outcomes, as well as fees and reputation.
## Background

The Graduate visa cannot be extended, so graduates who want to stay longer must switch to another route, such as the Skilled Worker visa. The UK has tightened immigration rules in recent years, including restrictions on bringing family members on student visas.
more: Most graduates will get 18 months instead of two years from January 2027.
Graduates of high-performing universities keep two years.
The list of qualifying universities has not been published.
stories.alt: Graduates in caps at a graduation ceremony (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: McElspeth / Wikimedia Commons, CC0

stories.h: South-East governors urge region to back Tinubu at APC women's rally in Enugu
stories.p: The governors of Enugu, Imo and Ebonyi, and a representative of Anambra's governor, have reportedly urged South-East voters to support President Tinubu's re-election at an APC women's rally in Enugu. The call sets up a direct contest with Peter Obi in his home region.
body: Four South-East state governments have thrown their weight behind President Bola Tinubu's re-election bid, in a show of support in a region widely seen as Peter Obi's stronghold.
## What happened

At an APC Women Mega Rally and Empowerment Programme for the South-East at Okpara Square, Enugu, on Saturday, 31 October 2026, the governors reportedly urged residents to back the President and APC candidates at all levels in the January 2027 elections.
## What the governors said

Enugu Governor Peter Mbah said the region should build on the government's economic reforms rather than change course, comparing it to a sailor who does not abandon his ship mid-sea. He also described an empowerment programme for 5,000 women across the five South-East states. Imo Governor Hope Uzodimma said Igbo people were now seeing real inclusion and development under Tinubu, and that improved federal allocations had helped his state pay salaries and pensions regularly. Ebonyi Governor Francis Nwifuru praised the APC's skills programmes and denied links to any coalition outside the party. Anambra Governor Charles Soludo was represented by his deputy, Gilbert Ibezim, who said the region should repay the administration with votes. Deputy Speaker Benjamin Kalu also spoke, noting that no Igbo person had been president in six decades and praising the South East Development Commission.
## Background

Peter Obi, the NDC presidential candidate and a former Anambra governor, won most of the South East in the 2023 presidential election. He has said he would serve only one term if elected, while some APC figures argue the region should aim for a longer stay in power through alliances. Obi had not responded to the rally at the time of the report.
## What happens next
Both the APC and the NDC are expected to intensify their campaigns in the South East, which is likely to be one of the most closely watched regions in the election.
more: Governors Mbah, Uzodimma and Nwifuru spoke at the rally; Soludo was represented.
They urged the region to back Tinubu in January 2027.
The South East is seen as Peter Obi's stronghold.
stories.credit: Photo: Nosa Asemota / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Davido and VeryDarkMan unfollow each other on Instagram as feud deepens
stories.p: Davido and VeryDarkMan have reportedly unfollowed each other on Instagram, the latest sign that their friendship has broken down. The move comes days after Kokopee spoke about the rift and Davido backed Zlatan's chart-topping song aimed at VDM.
body: The rift between Davido and social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) has moved to a new stage, with the two reportedly unfollowing each other on Instagram.
## What happened

Checks on Saturday, 31 October 2026, reportedly showed that Davido, who has more than 31 million followers, had removed VDM from his following list, and that VDM, who has more than 3 million followers, had done the same. Neither appears to have blocked the other, and neither has publicly explained the move.
## The build-up

The two were once close allies, but their friendship broke down earlier this year. This week, VDM's friend Kokopee said he had tried to bring them back together and that VDM felt betrayed by the singer. Davido responded with a 'cap' emoji, suggesting he disputed the account. He also congratulated rapper Zlatan Ibile on 'Inferno', a chart-topping song widely seen as a jab at VDM.
## VDM's court case
Separately, VDM announced that a criminal case brought against him by the police had been struck out, and he shared his excitement about the ruling.
## How people reacted

Fans were divided. Some praised Davido for cutting ties, while others criticised him and urged him to support VDM's charity work instead. Many said the unfollow confirmed that a reconciliation was unlikely for now.
more: Davido and VDM have reportedly unfollowed each other.
The move follows Davido's reaction to Kokopee and Zlatan's 'Inferno'.
VDM says a police case against him was struck out.

stories.h: Africa Energy Bank begins operations in Abuja with $5bn capital
stories.p: The Africa Energy Bank, set up by Afreximbank and the African Petroleum Producers' Organisation, has begun operations at its headquarters in Abuja and named Helmy Ghazi as its first president. It aims to help close a $200 billion gap in energy investment across Africa.
body: A new pan-African bank dedicated to financing energy projects has officially started work in Nigeria's capital.
## What happened

The Africa Energy Bank held its first general meeting in Abuja and named Helmy Ghazi as its first president, according to a statement by the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) reported on Sunday, 1 November 2026. The bank has an authorised capital of $5 billion.
## What the bank will do

The bank was set up by Afreximbank and the African Petroleum Producers' Organisation (APPO) to fund oil, gas and other energy infrastructure on the continent. Afreximbank estimates that Africa needs about $200 billion in energy investment to meet its development needs. Supporters of the bank say it will help African producers finance projects at a time when many Western lenders have pulled back from funding oil and gas.
## Background

Nigeria won the bid to host the bank's headquarters, beating other African countries, and the Federal Government has promoted the institution as a sign of investor confidence. African oil producers have long complained that it is difficult to raise money for fossil fuel projects as global banks shift towards renewable energy. The bank is expected to fund a mix of projects, including gas processing, refineries and power generation.
## What it means

For Nigeria, hosting the bank could bring jobs, international meetings and closer ties with energy investors, though analysts say its success will depend on how quickly it can raise funds and start lending.
more: The bank has $5bn authorised capital and is based in Abuja.
Helmy Ghazi is its first president.
It aims to help close a $200bn energy investment gap.

stories.h: Social media clout without financial growth is a wasted opportunity: what Daniel Regha can learn from VDM's RATEL
stories.p: Daniel Regha has questioned VeryDarkMan's move from activism into business with his RATEL brand. But VDM's shift raises a bigger question for every Nigerian influencer: what are you building with all that attention?
body: Daniel Regha has weighed in on VeryDarkMan's growing RATEL business, writing on X that VDM had gone "from activist, to NGO business, to CEO" and "from criticizing business owners to joining the same businesses to make profit."

His post drew mixed reactions. One user replied that anyone who has not yet understood VDM is to be pitied, while another asked what VDM is supposed to do with the money he makes from social media: give it all away and own nothing because he is an activist?
## Influence without a business

Sometimes one wonders whether Daniel Regha sees the business opportunities sitting right in front of him. For someone who commands so much attention on X, sparks conversations almost daily and has built a considerable following, you would expect him to have turned that influence into something financially rewarding by now.
Perhaps the fear of what people will say is holding him back.
## You are only a tenant

Many influencers forget that they do not own these platforms. They are simply tenants. Facebook, X, TikTok and Instagram can suspend an account, restrict its reach or change their policies overnight, and years of gathering followers could suddenly amount to very little.
## What VDM seems to understand
VeryDarkMan appears to understand something many influencers have yet to figure out: popularity has an expiry date. The same people cheering you today may move on to another personality tomorrow.

Instead of depending entirely on public attention, he is gradually converting his influence into a business. He is introducing products, building a customer base and creating something that could keep generating income long after the social media excitement fades. That is smart thinking.
## People will always talk
Imagine spending years building an audience of hundreds of thousands, or even millions, of people, only to have nothing financially sustainable to show for it.

If you have the audience, build a business. Sell products, offer services, create something valuable and earn legitimate money from the influence you have worked hard to establish. If you sell something, people will criticise you. If you remain broke, those same people will still have something to say. The people whose opinions you fear will not come together to pay your rent, feed your family or settle your bills.
## The real question

The advice to Daniel Regha and other social media personalities is simple: stop treating online popularity as a lifetime achievement, and find a way to turn that attention into lasting value. VDM may have his critics, but his decision to venture into business deserves recognition.
Because when the followers stop cheering and the cameras stop rolling, the real question will be: what did you build with all that influence?
What do you think? Should influencers concentrate on entertaining their followers, or should they use their popularity to build businesses?
more: Daniel Regha called VDM's journey 'all direction'.
Social media users were split in their replies.
Influencers are tenants on platforms they do not own.
stories.alt: VeryDarkMan in RATEL Power gear and in front of RATEL power station boxes, beside screenshots of posts on X by Daniel Regha and other users
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija

stories.h: US appeals court puts hold on order to reopen 2027 visa lottery
stories.p: A US appeals court has reportedly paused a lower court order that required the State Department to open registration for the 2027 Diversity Visa lottery. Tens of thousands of African hopefuls now have no confirmed date to apply while the appeal continues.
body: Hopes of an imminent opening of the US Diversity Visa lottery for 2027 have been put on hold after a federal appeals court intervened, according to reports on Sunday, 1 November 2026.
## What happened

The US Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit reportedly granted an emergency stay on 29 October, pausing an order issued by District Judge Jinsook Ohta on 14 October. That order, made in a case brought by immigration law firm Red Eagle Law against Secretary of State Marco Rubio, had required the State Department to announce registration dates, open applications and notify selected entrants by 3 December. The lower court had set 29 October for publishing registration details and 1 November for opening the application window.
## Why it was paused

The appeals judges reportedly found that the law firm had not shown that its financial interest in representing lottery winners was closely enough linked to the programme's goal of increasing immigration from under-represented countries. The court said its decision was not an endorsement of the State Department's failure to open the programme.
## Who is affected

The lottery offers up to 55,000 US immigrant visas each year to people from countries with low rates of immigration to the United States, and African applicants have long made up a large share of winners. Tens of thousands of hopefuls across the continent now have no confirmed registration date. Nigeria has been excluded from the lottery for several years because of its high number of immigrants to the US, but many Nigerians follow the programme closely and some qualify through a spouse's or parent's country of birth.
## What happens next
The registration window will remain closed until the appeal is decided or the State Department announces its own dates.
more: The Ninth Circuit paused an order to open the 2027 lottery.
The lower court had set 1 November for registration to open.
Applicants must wait for the appeal to be decided.

stories.h: Chelsea beat Manchester United 2-0 as Carrick insists he will stay in charge
stories.p: Manchester United lost 2-0 at Chelsea on Saturday, leaving them 17th in the Premier League, one point above the relegation zone. Manager Michael Carrick said he expects to remain in charge for Tuesday's Champions League game against Roma.
body: Pressure on Manchester United manager Michael Carrick has grown after another defeat in the Premier League.
## The match

Chelsea beat United 2-0 on Saturday, 31 October 2026, with both goals coming in the second half from Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer, according to reports. It was United's fourth league defeat of the season and leaves them 17th in the table, just one point above the relegation zone.
## What Carrick said

Speaking to TNT Sports after the game, Carrick was asked directly whether he expected to still be in charge for United's next match, the Champions League tie against Roma at Old Trafford on Tuesday. He reportedly answered simply that he did.
## Background

Carrick, a former United midfielder, has faced growing criticism after a poor start to the season. Reports earlier this week said the club's board had decided against sacking him for now. The club is also facing decisions over several senior defenders whose contracts expire at the end of the season, with Super Eagles defender Calvin Bassey among the players reportedly being considered as a replacement.
## What happens next
Tuesday's Champions League match against Roma is now seen as an important test for the manager. Fans are divided, with some calling for patience and others for an immediate change.
more: Rogers and Palmer scored for Chelsea in the second half.
United are 17th, a point above the relegation zone.
Carrick says he expects to be in charge against Roma.

stories.h: Russia detains teenager over planned attack on Moscow museum after US warning
stories.p: Russia's FSB security service says it has detained a teenager suspected of planning an attack on Moscow's Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve, acting on information from US law enforcement. The US Embassy had warned of a credible threat of a mass-casualty attack at the site.
body: The United States Embassy in Moscow has issued an urgent warning about a possible attack at one of the Russian capital's best-known historic sites.
## What the embassy said

In a statement on Saturday, 31 October 2026, the embassy said it was aware of a credible threat of an event that could cause mass casualties at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve. It advised American citizens to avoid the site that day, stay alert and avoid crowds, and said the US government was coordinating with Russian authorities.
## Russia's response

Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB) confirmed it had received information from its American counterparts about possible preparations for a terrorist attack in Moscow and said it was taking appropriate action. Russian media reported that the museum reserve was temporarily closed and that police restricted access to the surrounding park.
## Background

Tsaritsyno is a large 18th-century palace and park complex in the south of Moscow, popular with tourists and families. The warning is reminiscent of March 2024, when the US Embassy warned of a possible attack on large gatherings in Moscow shortly before gunmen attacked the Crocus City Hall concert venue, killing more than 140 people. The rare cooperation between US and Russian security services comes at a time of high tension between Russia and the West over Ukraine and Europe.
## Suspect detained

On Monday, 2 November, reports said the FSB had detained a minor suspected of planning the attack on the museum reserve, acting on information from US law enforcement. The suspect was not named, and Russian authorities did not say exactly when the arrest took place.
## What happens next
Russian authorities are expected to give more details of the investigation. The case is a rare example of security cooperation between the two countries amid wider tensions.
more: The FSB says it detained a teenager over the planned attack.
It acted on information from US law enforcement.
The US Embassy had warned of a credible threat.

stories.h: VeryDarkMan's RATEL brand reportedly records ₦90 million in sales in one day
stories.p: VeryDarkMan and his RATEL brand have reportedly made about ₦90 million in sales in a single day, after he shared bank alerts showing a stream of customer payments. If the figure holds, it would be one of the strongest signs yet that the social media critic is turning his influence into a serious business.
body: VeryDarkMan (VDM) and his RATEL brand have reportedly recorded about ₦90 million in sales in just one day, a figure that has set social media talking about how far the activist-turned-businessman could go.

The claim followed a post showing VDM in RATEL Power branded safety gear, holding up his phone, alongside a screenshot of bank alerts. The alerts, all dated 31 October 2026, show several customer payments for RATEL products, including a 600-watt power station, with the account balance climbing above ₦83 million.
## From critic to businessman

VDM first became widely known for his social media videos and for publicly challenging powerful figures. Over time he has moved into importing products from China, building his own brand and steadily establishing himself in business. RATEL now sells items ranging from power stations to sensor lights.
## A marketing style built on openness

What stands out most is how he markets the brand. Rather than relying on traditional adverts, he brings his audience along with him. He shows them the products, explains how they work and tests them publicly, so followers are watching the business grow in real time.
Whether people like him or not, few can deny the attention he has drawn to RATEL.
## Sales are not profit

It is worth remembering that ₦90 million in sales is not ₦90 million in profit. Running a business comes with stock costs, shipping, staff, risk and plenty of other challenges, and the figure itself has not been independently confirmed.

Still, if RATEL keeps up this momentum, many observers believe it could grow into a multibillion-naira business group. Ten years from now, people may look back at these early videos and remember exactly how it all started.
## Why it matters

Nigeria needs more young people who can turn online influence into productive businesses that create jobs and last. VDM's journey, with its struggles, criticism, mistakes and determination, is playing out in full public view.
So the question is simple: do you believe RATEL can become one of Nigeria's biggest indigenous brands in the next five years?
more: Bank alerts shared online show multiple customer payments for RATEL products.
Sales figures are not the same as profit.
Could RATEL become one of Nigeria's biggest home-grown brands?

stories.h: Obasanjo and daughter Iyabo trade jokes on stage at Abeokuta symposium
stories.p: Former President Olusegun Obasanjo and his daughter, former senator Iyabo Obasanjo, drew laughter at a symposium in Abeokuta when she jokingly said she did not know him and he replied that it was already an abuse of AI. The event focused on using artificial intelligence for development.
body: Former President Olusegun Obasanjo and his daughter, former senator Iyabo Obasanjo, provided a light-hearted moment at a public event in Abeokuta, Ogun State, with a playful exchange that quickly spread online.
## What happened

At the Ajibosin Platform symposium, held at the Olusegun Obasanjo Presidential Library on Friday, 30 October 2026, Iyabo reportedly greeted the dignitaries in her opening address and acknowledged her father last, joking that he was someone she did not know. When the former President took the microphone, he responded that the abuse of artificial intelligence had already started, since his own daughter now claimed not to know her father. The audience laughed at both remarks.
## About the event

The symposium, part of the Odun Omo Olowu festival, focused on using artificial intelligence to solve grassroots problems and speed up national development. It was at the same event that Obasanjo criticised President Bola Tinubu's attitude to borrowing, saying debt destroys generations, and warned against relying too heavily on advice from foreign-trained economists.
## Background

Iyabo Obasanjo is a public health specialist who served as Ogun State Commissioner for Health and later as a senator representing Ogun Central. She is currently the PDP candidate for Ogun Central in the 2027 elections. Father and daughter have had a well-publicised strained relationship in the past, which made their friendly exchange all the more talked about.
## How people reacted
Many social media users enjoyed the moment, saying it showed a warmer side of the former President, while others joked about the role of AI in family relationships.
more: Iyabo joked she did not know her father.
Obasanjo replied that it was 'abuse of AI'.
The symposium focused on AI for development.

stories.h: Pro-Tinubu group warns APC that Imo West row could cost it South East support
stories.p: The Renewed Hope Foot Soldiers for Tinubu has warned that the fight over the APC's Imo West Senate ticket could weaken the party in the South East. The group wants Governor Hope Uzodimma to be allowed to pursue his ambitions and called for dialogue, after a court recognised Rochas Okorocha as the candidate.
body: A pro-Tinubu support group has warned the All Progressives Congress (APC) that the dispute over its candidate for the Imo West Senatorial District could hurt the party in the South East ahead of 2027.
## What the group said

In a statement signed by its national president, Gbenga Owojori, and reported on Saturday, 31 October 2026, the Renewed Hope Foot Soldiers for Tinubu reacted to the Federal High Court ruling that recognised former governor Rochas Okorocha, rather than Governor Hope Uzodimma, as the APC candidate for Imo West. The group argued that shutting out candidates from the South East could weaken the coalition President Bola Tinubu needs for re-election.
## Its demands

The group called on party leaders to resolve the matter through inclusive dialogue and transparent party processes, and said Uzodimma should be given a fair chance to pursue his ambitions, including a possible bid for the Senate presidency. It also made claims, which it did not support with evidence, that some senior political figures were working against Uzodimma. Those named have not responded to the claims.
## Background

Okorocha went to court claiming he won the APC primary on 18 May, while the party's returning officer declared Uzodimma the winner. The court ordered INEC to publish Okorocha's name, and former APC national chairman Abdullahi Ganduje later visited Okorocha to congratulate him. The case also raises the question of whether a sitting governor can contest a Senate seat while still in office. Uzodimma has not said publicly whether he will appeal.
## What happens next
The dispute is expected to continue in court and within the party, with both camps seeking the backing of the national leadership.
more: The group says the row could cost the APC South East support.
It wants Uzodimma to be allowed to pursue his ambitions.
A court recognised Okorocha as the APC candidate.

stories.h: Akwa Ibom announces 13th-month pension bonus and ₦10,000 payment for retirees
stories.p: Akwa Ibom Governor Umo Eno has announced a 13th-month pension bonus for all pensioners in the state, plus a ₦10,000 welfare payment to be paid with November pensions. He said ₦100 billion of an inherited ₦111 billion gratuity backlog has been cleared.
body: Pensioners in Akwa Ibom State are set to receive an extra month's pension, Governor Umo Eno has announced.
## What was announced

Speaking at the Ibom Hall Grounds in Uyo, in remarks reported on Saturday, 31 October 2026, the governor said all pensioners in the state would receive a 13th-month pension bonus. He also announced a separate ₦10,000 welfare payment, which will be paid together with November 2026 pensions. The exact amount and payment date of the 13th-month bonus were not stated in reports.
## Clearing the backlog

The governor reportedly said his government had paid ₦100 billion of a ₦111 billion gratuity backlog it inherited and planned to clear the remainder before the end of its first term. He also urged pensioners aged 65 and above to register for the state's free health insurance scheme for older people.
## Background

At the event, the Nigeria Union of Pensioners presented the governor with a merit award. Unpaid pensions and gratuities are a long-standing problem in many Nigerian states, and retirees have often protested over delays. Some states have recently announced extra payments to help workers and pensioners cope with rising living costs, while the Federal Government this week unveiled a ₦50,000 monthly cash relief scheme for vulnerable households.
## How people reacted
Pensioners welcomed the announcement, while some residents called on other states to follow the example.
more: All pensioners in the state will get a 13th-month bonus.
A ₦10,000 welfare payment comes with November pensions.
₦100bn of a ₦111bn gratuity backlog has reportedly been paid.
